Gold Rate Today Sargodha – Complete Guide to Gold Prices

Understand the gold rate today in Sargodha, 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K gold prices, per-tola and per-gram calculations, purity and the factors that affect jewellery prices.

📍 Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan 📅 Updated 5 September 2026 SM Gold Sargodha

If you are searching for gold rate today Sargodha, you may want to know the current value of gold before buying jewellery, selling old gold, planning a wedding purchase or comparing jewellery prices.

Searches such as gold rate today in Sargodha, gold rate in Sargodha today, today gold rate Sargodha and sargodha gold rate today all represent slightly different ways of looking for the same basic information: what is the current market value of gold and how does that value translate into a real jewellery transaction?

Important: Online gold prices should be treated as reference information. The final local buying or selling price may differ because of timing, purity, weight, market conditions, workmanship and other applicable charges.

What Is the Gold Rate Today in Sargodha?

The gold rate in Sargodha represents a market reference for the value of gold at a particular purity and weight. The price is not permanently fixed and can change as international markets, currency values and local trading conditions change.

When people search for gold rate in Sargodha today, they should check more than just the number. The date, time, purity, weight unit and market source are all important.

Current Gold Rate Reference for Sargodha

For reference, a published Pakistan market benchmark for 5 September 2026 listed 24K gold at approximately Rs 455,000 per tola. The corresponding purity-based figures were approximately Rs 417,202 for 22K, Rs 398,238 for 21K and Rs 341,347 for 18K per tola.

24K Gold Rate in Sargodha

Customers searching for the 24k gold rate Sargodha market are generally looking for the value of high-purity gold. 24K represents approximately 99.9% fine gold and is commonly used as a reference when discussing the value of pure gold.

The important point is to check the unit. A website might quote a figure per tola while another source might show a price per gram. These numbers cannot be compared directly until they are converted to the same unit.

22K Gold Rate in Sargodha

22K gold contains approximately 91.6% pure gold and is widely associated with traditional jewellery. When comparing the 22k gold rate Sargodha, make sure the competing quotations use the same date, weight and purity.

The final price of a 22K jewellery item can also depend on its design, weight, workmanship, stone setting and other applicable charges.

21K Gold Rate in Sargodha

21K gold contains approximately 87.5% gold. It is another important jewellery purity used by customers in Pakistan.

When checking the 21k gold rate Sargodha market, do not compare it directly with 24K without accounting for the purity difference. The same weight can have a different underlying gold value at different karats.

18K Gold Rate in Sargodha

18K gold contains approximately 75% pure gold. It is used in jewellery where different material characteristics and design requirements are desired.

Customers searching for the 18k gold rate Sargodha should compare the rate with other 18K quotations rather than with a 24K benchmark.

Gold Price Per Tola in Sargodha

Gold is commonly discussed by tola in Pakistan. One tola is approximately 11.664 grams.

Therefore, if you know the per-tola benchmark, you can estimate the approximate per-gram amount by dividing the figure by 11.664.

Example: A hypothetical gold price of Rs 100,000 per tola would equal approximately Rs 8,573 per gram. This is only a unit conversion example, not a live market quotation.

Gold Price Per Gram in Sargodha

The gold price per gram Sargodha search is particularly useful when evaluating small jewellery pieces such as rings, earrings, pendants and lightweight bracelets.

Remember that gram describes weight, while karat describes purity. A one-gram 24K item and a one-gram 18K item do not contain the same amount of pure gold.

Gold Price for 10 Grams in Sargodha

Some customers prefer the gold price 10 gram Sargodha format because it gives a larger metric unit for price comparison.

To estimate a 10-gram price from a per-gram value, multiply the per-gram figure by ten. Always make sure the calculation uses the same purity.

Why Does the Gold Rate Change?

The today gold rate Sargodha can change because gold is connected to broader financial and commodity markets.

  • International gold-market movements.
  • Changes in the USD to PKR exchange rate.
  • Local supply and demand.
  • Market sentiment and trading conditions.
  • Timing of the quoted price.
  • Differences between benchmark and retail transaction prices.

Why Is Jewellery More Expensive Than the Gold Rate?

A common mistake is to assume that the daily market gold rate is automatically the final price of a jewellery item.

A finished jewellery quotation can contain several components, including the underlying gold value, workmanship, design complexity, stone work, wastage policies and other applicable charges.

Net Gold Weight

Jewellery may contain stones or components that are not gold. Ask for the net gold weight when discussing the metal value of an item.

Making and Labour Charges

A detailed or complicated design can require more craftsmanship than a simple piece. Therefore, two items with similar gold weight can have different final prices.

How to Check Gold Rate Before Buying

  1. Check the publication date and update time.
  2. Confirm the gold purity or karat.
  3. Confirm whether the rate is per gram, per 10 grams or per tola.
  4. Ask for the exact net gold weight.
  5. Ask how workmanship or labour charges are calculated.
  6. Confirm the current local quotation immediately before payment.

Gold Buying vs Gold Selling in Sargodha

The amount a customer pays when buying new jewellery is not necessarily the same as the amount received when selling old gold.

When selling old gold, ask how the purity is assessed, how the net weight is calculated and which applicable rate is being used. When buying jewellery, request a complete quotation showing the metal value and applicable workmanship or other charges.

Sarafa Bazar Sargodha Gold Rate

Customers searching for sarafa bazar Sargodha gold rate are often comparing online information with the rate available from a local jewellery business.

Online sources can be useful for understanding the market, but different websites may update at different times or report different reference markets. Local transaction prices can also vary according to the nature of the purchase or sale.

What Should You Ask a Jewellery Shop?

  • What is the current gold rate?
  • Which purity is being used?
  • What is the exact net gold weight?
  • Is the rate quoted per gram or per tola?
  • What workmanship charges apply?
  • Are stones or other components included?
  • What is the final amount payable?
